caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Mar 22–26 is here.

Knee grumbling when you get up from a chair? Leaning nose over knees and practising slow sit to stands, 10 reps twice a day, can help. A side stitch on a run often eases if you slow to a walk and breathe out slowly. Front-desk staff can stand and walk about every 30 minutes. And reaching into the back seat? Hop out and open the back door instead.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🦘
